_readme: Copy this file to config.json in the same folder.
mode local = poller starts Cursor local SDK agent with real jira-ai-fix skill on this PC.
mode notify = toast + clipboard only (paste in Desktop).
Requires Node.js + CURSOR_API_KEY (Dashboard API key) for mode local.
investigateModel = phase 1 (Jira/HDTN/root-cause/plan/code). wrapUpModel = phase 2 (feature branch/RCA draft/wrap-up).
localModel is a legacy alias for investigateModel when investigateModel is omitted.
lockStaleMinutes = orphan lock reclaim / heartbeat-stale WARN when no live owner PID; live PIDs are never auto-reclaimed (use -Force).
notifyEmail true sends investigation started/resumed, completed-draft, and failure emails.
